Interface IConfigSpigot

All Superinterfaces:
IBlockAnalyzerConfig, IConfig, IRestartable
public interface IConfigSpigot extends IConfig, IBlockAnalyzerConfig
Represents the configuration of the plugin for the Spigot platform.
